text: The attendant points toward the receiving lounge and the stair hall. He offers to take a cloak, bag, or other burden and promises a numbered ticket for anything left behind.

views.text: The shabby goat-faced attendant points out the worn reception lounge and the stair hall. He offers a numbered ticket for any cloak or bag left in the cramped coatroom.
The composed palace attendant gestures toward the receiving lounge and stair hall. Beneath the brass lamps, he offers a numbered ticket for any cloak or bag left in his care.
